subject: Conditional Panel Info Passed to server

messages.author: 89c04f2e40dabf01
messages.subject: Conditional Panel Info Passed to server
parts:
Below is a very minimal example of my problem. My ui.R code has a conditional panel allowing the user to choose two options for reading in a file. The "local" option means they can type in a path or the "remote" option means they would use a typical fileInput method.

My question however is regarding the server.R file and how I should construct the condition so it behaves one way if local is selected and another if remote is selected. Really my question then is how the server.R file sees which option is chosen in the UI and then how do I wrap the conditional expression around the way I want to read in the file given how the user chooses to locate the file?

To be clear, I don't need clarity on how to actually read in the files, just how to consider the conditional in the server.R.

Thank you

### Begin ui.R
shinyUI(fluidPage(

  # Application title
  titlePanel("Hello Shiny!"),

  # Sidebar with a slider input for the number of bins
  sidebarLayout(
 
    sidebarPanel(
      radioButtons('readOption', 'Choose Read In Option',
            c('Local Option' = 'local',
            'Remote Option' = 'remote'),
            selected = 'remote',
            ),    
   
    conditionalPanel(
        condition = "input.readOption == 'local'",
        textInput("path2dor", label = "DOR File Path and File Name",
            value = "path\\dor.txt")
    ),
   
    conditionalPanel(
        condition = "input.readOption == 'remote'",
        fileInput('path2dor', 'Choose the DOR .txt file to format',
            accept=c('text/csv',
            'text/comma-separated-values,text/plain', '.csv'))             
    )   
    ),

    # Show a plot of the generated distribution
    mainPanel(
      h4('Hello World')
    )
  )
))

### Begin server.R
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
 
      File <- reactive({
        if(input$readOption == 'local'){
            read.csv(infile$datapath)
        }
        if(input$readOption == 'remote'){
            read.csv(infile$datapath)
        }
    })
})

messages.subject: Re: Conditional Panel Info Passed to server
parts:
You've got it right. input$readOption will change to 'local' or 'remote' when the user selects the radios. 

You won't be able to see this in your example app though, if that's where your question comes from. infile doesn't exist, and nothing is actually using the File reactive. 
If you change File to an observer, you should see the app error out when it starts.
